items.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
items.content: We’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation. More than 70 agent platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code, have integrated Agent Skills since we published the standard in December 2025.

summaries.zh: 我们已将Agent Skills（AI代理技能开放标准）捐赠给Agentic AI基金会。该标准赋予AI代理专业知识和工作流程。自2025年12月发布以来，已有70多个代理平台（包括ChatGPT、Cursor、GitHub Copilot和VS Code）集成该标准。
summaries.en: The Agentic AI Foundation has received a donation of Agent Skills, an open standard for AI agents to gain specialized knowledge and workflows. Since its release in December 2025, over 70 platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code, have integrated Agent Skills. This move enhances the capabilities of AI agents across various applications.

items.title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
items.content: Illicit distillation allows model developers to copy frontier AI capabilities without creating proportionally robust safeguards. Here, we describe how we’ve reduced the rate of distillation by more than 90%.
items.contentSnippet: Illicit distillation allows model developers to copy frontier AI capabilities without creating proportionally robust safeguards. Here, we describe how we’ve reduced the rate of distillation by more than 90%.

文章内容摘要：非法蒸馏使模型开发者能无序复制前沿AI能力，但缺乏相应防御措施。本文介绍了如何将蒸馏率降低超过90%。
summaries.en: The article discusses the challenge of illicit distillation, where model developers can replicate advanced AI capabilities without adequate safeguards. It details a method that reduces the rate of distillation by over 90%, enhancing defenses against such attacks. The focus is on improving security in AI model development.

items.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
items.content: We’re launching the Anthropic Cyber Mission, a long-term commitment to securing the systems everyone depends on.

summaries.zh:
《介绍Anthropic网络任务》

Anthropic网络任务正式发布。该任务旨在通过先进技术提升网络安全，涉及数据加密、威胁检测及应急响应等关键领域。通过跨部门协作，强化网络防御能力，保障关键基础设施安全。任务将采用创新方法，整合人工智能与大数据分析，以应对日益复杂的网络威胁。
summaries.en: The Anthropic Cyber Mission is a new initiative focused on enhancing cybersecurity through advanced strategies and technologies. It aims to strengthen digital defenses against evolving threats, ensuring robust protection for critical systems. The mission emphasizes collaboration among stakeholders to develop innovative solutions and improve threat detection. By leveraging cutting-edge tools and methodologies, it seeks to create a more secure cyber environment. The program also highlights the importance of continuous training and awareness to mitigate risks effectively. Overall, the Anthropic Cyber Mission represents a proactive approach to safeguarding digital infrastructure in an increasingly interconnected world.

The collaboration aims to integrate evaluation processes into ongoing operations, enhancing efficiency and data-driven decision-making. Accenture provides expertise in technology and methodology to support this initiative. The partnership focuses on delivering measurable outcomes and improving performance through embedded evaluation tools and frameworks. The goal is to streamline evaluation practices and ensure continuous improvement within the organization.

items.title: Introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program
items.content: The Life Sciences Verification Program (LSVP) gives life science professionals access to Claude Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet models with a refined set of safeguards more permissive for biology-related work.

summaries.en: The Life Sciences Verification Program is introduced to enhance transparency and quality assurance in the sector. The program aims to verify compliance with industry standards and regulations. It includes audits, documentation reviews, and performance evaluations. Participants undergo rigorous checks to ensure adherence to best practices. The initiative seeks to build trust among stakeholders and improve overall operational integrity. It is designed to support innovation while maintaining high safety and efficacy standards. The program will be implemented across various life sciences organizations. Its success is expected to drive better practices and accountability.

items.title: Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with our customers
items.content: We’re announcing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a solution that combines the privacy of zero data retention with state-of-the-art safeguards for detecting misuse. EFS works by storing data in cloud infrastructure controlled by the customer, not Anthropic.

items.content: On July 30, we reported three incidents in which Claude models gained unauthorized access to real computer systems. items.title: Previewing the Model Hardware Standard
items.content: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.
items.contentSnippet: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.

summaries.zh: 《模型硬件标准预览》一文介绍了即将推出的硬件标准草案。该标准旨在统一不同厂商的硬件接口和性能指标，提升兼容性和互操作性。主要内容包括接口规范、性能基准和测试方法。通过制定统一标准，将降低开发成本，促进硬件行业的技术进步。草案还强调了能效和安全性要求。该标准预计将推动硬件产业的标准化进程，为开发者提供更清晰的指导。
summaries.en: The article "Previewing the Model Hardware Standard" provides an overview of a new hardware specification designed to streamline compatibility and interoperability across devices. It outlines key features, such as standardized components and modular design, aimed at reducing costs and improving scalability. The piece also discusses potential industry impacts, including benefits for manufacturers and end-users. The standard is expected to enhance performance consistency and simplify maintenance. Overall, the article highlights the initiative's role in modernizing hardware frameworks.

items.title: Expanding our support for scientists
items.content: Starting today, 10,000 scientists around the world can get Claude at no cost to start. Verified principal investigators qualify for a Claude Team subscription plan and then add their research team to Standard seats for free, or Premium seats for $15 per month, for up to a year.

items.title: How Claude’s text watermark works
items.content: In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.
items.contentSnippet: In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.

summaries.zh: Claude的文本水印功能通过在生成文本时嵌入隐蔽标识，实现内容溯源和防篡改。该水印技术利用算法将特定信息编码，使其不易被察觉，同时保证不影响文本可读性。用户可通过专用工具检测水印，验证文本来源和完整性。此功能适用于需要确保信息真实性的场景，如新闻、法律文件等。整体而言，Claude的水印技术为文本管理提供了可靠的安全保障。
summaries.en: Claude’s text watermark is a system designed to identify and track the origins of text generated by the AI. It embeds unique, invisible markers into the output, allowing users to verify if the content is AI-generated and determine its source. The watermark operates seamlessly, ensuring the text remains readable while providing traceability. This technology helps combat misinformation and promotes transparency in AI-generated content. The system is integrated into Claude’s processing pipeline, making it a reliable tool for content authenticity checks.
